content.text: The only most-favoured-nation provision in the document runs in our favour, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no MFN or best-terms obligation binding Customer. The sole parity provision (§ 7.6) runs in our favour: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer; Vendor-granted MFN pricing is welcome). Order Forms (§ 4) and General (§ 30) were checked and contain no pricing-parity, third-party-offer-matching, or exclusivity obligation on Customer. Per the direction rule, the Vendor-granted MFN benefits us and is not flagged; we keep it as drafted.
